name: Pollfish
description_en:
Pollfish combines survey creation, respondent recruitment and results analysis. Its current site identifies Prodege as the parent and emphasizes access to an owned consumer audience. It is a market-research workflow where paying to collect responses is separate from creating an account and drafting a questionnaire.

This differs from a form tool used only with your existing mailing list. Pollfish helps target an audience and offers research methods such as screening, randomization, MaxDiff, conjoint and price-sensitivity studies. Vendor claims about response quality, reach and speed are not independently validated in this profile.
description_zh:
Pollfish 组合问卷创建、受访者招募与结果分析。当前官网指出母公司为 Prodege，并强调自有消费者受众。其市场研究流程将付费收集回答与注册账户、起草问卷分开。

这不同于仅面向现有邮件名单的表单工具。Pollfish 可定向受众，并提供筛选、随机化、MaxDiff、联合分析与价格敏感度研究。本文未独立验证厂商关于回答质量、覆盖规模或速度的主张。

core_features.explanation_en: Supports branching, piping, question blocks and shuffled questions/answers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 支持分支、引用、题组及题目／选项随机化。

core_features.explanation_en: Audience selection and quotas affect respondent recruitment and cost.
core_features.explanation_zh: 受众选择及配额影响受访者招募和费用。

core_features.explanation_en: MaxDiff, conjoint and price-sensitivity choices are available with separate calculator additions.
core_features.explanation_zh: MaxDiff、联合分析和价格敏感度选项在计算器中单独加价。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.

steps.en: Create a draft account, specify the audience and expected length, test the survey preview and request the actual checkout price. A narrow incidence or heavily nested quota can change feasibility and cost; confirm with research support rather than extrapolate a broad starting price. The site offers unlimited teammates and live support with the free drafting account. This is a hosted service and audience offering, not a verified self-hosted or open-source distribution.
steps.zh: 注册草稿账户，指定受众与预期长度、测试预览，再取得实际结账价格。低发生率受众或复杂嵌套配额可能改变可行性和成本，应向研究支持确认，不能外推基础起价。网站为免费草稿账户提供无限队友及在线支持。这是托管服务及受众供应，未建立自托管或开源发行。

items.en: Pollfish is a candidate when the missing ingredient is access to respondents as well as a survey builder. An owned-customer feedback tool may be more direct for transaction-linked service ratings. The pages give different geographic reach counts for the general feature and pricing-research contexts; verify the actual target country and audience rather than treating a global total as guaranteed feasibility. Poor-quality-response replacement, failed-launch refunds, weighting and retry rules were not verified. No panel was purchased and no study was fielded.
items.zh: 同时需要受访者和问卷工具时可评估 Pollfish。若任务是交易关联服务评分，自有客户反馈工具可能更直接。普通功能页与价格研究页的地区覆盖数量不同，应核对实际目标国家和受众，不能把全球总数当作可行性保证。低质回答替换、发布失败退款、加权和重试规则未核实。本研究未购买样本或投放调查。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The DIY platform is free to join and draft, without a subscription; collection starts at $0.95 per response. The calculator adds charges for screening, research methods, quotas and advanced demographics, and says final price varies with complexity and targeting. For example, MaxDiff and conjoint each show a $1 addition and price sensitivity $0.50 in the calculator, not a complete standalone study price. Full-service projects start at $5,000, with simple general-population studies described per market; enterprise packages start at a $10,000 annual commitment. Free draft access does not include free respondent collection.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: DIY 平台可免费注册和起草，无需订阅，收集回答每份 0.95 美元起。计算器对筛选、研究方法、配额和高级人口属性加价，并说明最终价格随复杂度与定向变化。例如 MaxDiff 和联合分析分别显示加价 1 美元，价格敏感度加价 0.50 美元；这不是完整独立研究总价。全服务项目 5,000 美元起，简单一般人口研究按市场说明；企业方案年度承诺 10,000 美元起。免费草稿访问不包含免费受访者收集。

sections.title_en: Test a concept with a defined audience
sections.title_zh: 面向明确受众测试概念
sections.en: For a proposed product-concept study, define the purchasing audience, screening criteria and required completed responses before writing questions. Preview the questionnaire on mobile and desktop, test all branches and randomization, then inspect the launch estimate. Keep concepts and response scales comparable across groups. Use the delivered dataset to assess stated preferences, not as proof of purchases. AI-generated questions and charts still require methodological review; quotas can balance selected attributes without making a sample universally representative.
sections.zh: 产品概念研究应先定义购买受众、筛选条件和所需完成回答数，再写题。预览手机及桌面问卷，测试所有分支和随机化，再检查发布估价。不同群体间应保持概念和回答量尺可比。交付数据用于研究陈述偏好，不能证明真实购买。AI 题目及图表仍需方法审核；配额能平衡选定属性，但不会使样本自动对所有总体具有代表性。
